<div class="grid [grid-template-areas:'header_header''menu_content''footer_footer'] grid-cols-[1fr_3fr] bg-sky-500 border-2 border-sky-900 gap-2 p-2 m-4">
    <div class="[grid-area:header] bg-sky-50 p-4">
        <h2 class="text-center text-xl text-black font-bold">My Header</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="[grid-area:menu] bg-sky-50 p-4">
        <a class="underline text-blue-600" href="#">Link 1</a>
        <br>
        <a class="underline text-blue-600" href="#">Link 2</a>
        <br>
        <a class="underline text-blue-600" href="#">Link 3</a>
        <br>
    </div>
    <div class="[grid-area:content] bg-sky-50 p-4">
        <h3 class="text-lg text-black font-bold">Lorem Ipsum</h3>
        <p>
            Lorem ipsum odor amet, consectetuer adipiscing elit.
            Ridiculus sit nisl laoreet facilisis aliquet. Potenti
            dignissim litora eget montes rhoncus sapien neque urna.
            Cursus libero sapien integer magnis ligula lobortis quam ut.
        </p>
    </div>
    <div class="[grid-area:footer] bg-sky-50 p-4">
        <h4 class="text-center text-base text-black font-bold">Footer</h4>
    </div>
</div>
